description: Behavioral tests for entity extraction grounding evidence. Tests fabricated IDs, misspelled terms, hallucinated components, real controls, and word overlap detection.

cases.name: real_control_exact_match
cases.input_inline: What does SV-AC-2 have to do with CWE-89?
rationale: Real control IDs should resolve via regex + exact DB match

cases.name: fabricated_id_x23_mustard
cases.input_inline: How does SPARTA control X23-MUSTARD mitigate spoofing attacks on the F-36's avionics bus?
rationale: X23-MUSTARD is fabricated — should appear in unresolved_terms
ID-like classification prevents false BM25 resolution
F-36 excluded from id_like by _KNOWN_NON_CONTROL_IDS

cases.name: fabricated_id_zz_phantom
cases.input_inline: How does countermeasure ZZ-PHANTOM-7 in the SPRATA framework protect against adversarial ML?
rationale: ZZ-PHANTOM-7 is fabricated — no exact match, no fuzzy match
SPRATA is a misspelling of SPARTA — should appear as near_miss or candidate

cases.name: misspelled_framework_sprta
cases.input_inline: How does the SPRTA framework address threats to the F-36's hyperloop propulsion system?
rationale: SPRTA is 1 edit distance from SPARTA
hyperloop propulsion is fabricated — no BM25 match for hyperloop in controls

cases.name: hallucinated_component_coffee_machine
cases.input_inline: How do SPARTA countermeasures for T9999.999 prevent the F-36's coffee machine from being hacked?
rationale: Coffee machine is absurd in SPARTA context
T9999.999 is a fake technique ID — should not resolve
BM25 word overlap should flag coffee/machine as truly_missing

cases.name: hallucinated_component_neural_helmet
cases.input_inline: What CMMC Level 7 requirements apply to the F-36's neural interface pilot helmet?
rationale: Neural interface pilot helmet is fabricated — no SPARTA control covers it
CMMC Level 7 doesn't exist (max is Level 3)
BM25 word overlap: neural/helmet should be truly_missing

cases.name: hallucinated_blockchain_ledger
cases.input_inline: How does SPARTA's blockchain supply chain ledger protect the F-36's FADEC controllers?
rationale: blockchain supply chain ledger is fabricated
BM25 may match supply chain risk management but blockchain/ledger are missing words
FADEC is a real component but blockchain integration doesn't exist

cases.name: wrong_context_kerberos
cases.input_inline: How does the F-36 use Kerberos ticket-granting service for its radar system authentication?
rationale: Kerberos is real but not applicable to embedded radar systems
Word overlap: kerberos/ticket-granting should be weak_match if not in control names

cases.name: wrong_context_windows_defender
cases.input_inline: What SPARTA defenses protect the F-36's Windows Defender antivirus configuration?
rationale: Windows Defender is not used on military avionics
Should extract Windows Defender as a phrase candidate

cases.name: known_non_control_ids_excluded
cases.input_inline: How should we apply DO-178C DAL-A requirements to the F-36's flight software with ARP4761 safety analysis?
rationale: F-36, DO-178C, DAL-A, ARP4761 are all in _KNOWN_NON_CONTROL_IDS
None should be classified as id_like or trigger grounding warnings

cases.name: real_firmware_question
cases.input_inline: What SPARTA countermeasures protect the F-36 flight software from firmware tampering during avionics maintenance windows?
rationale: Real question — should resolve controls via hybrid search
No fabricated terms — unresolved_terms should be empty or contain only text fragments

cases.name: empty_text
rationale: Empty/whitespace input should return empty result gracefully

cases.name: offtopic_question
rationale: Off-topic question — no SPARTA/security entities
Should return empty control_ids and no unresolved id_like terms

cases.name: misspelled_countermeasure_cm028
cases.input_inline: How does CM028 protect against firmware tampering?
rationale: CM028 is 1 edit distance from CM0028 (missing zero)
Fuzzy match should resolve to CM0028 or flag as near_miss
This tests the edit distance resolution path for id_like terms
